cowork.notes: Skills and sub-agents use Claude Code markdown formats; artifacts are real files staged in the connected project folder. Skill/agent directories are system-managed: a standalone skill installs via the Save skill flow (zip package), and plugins install from Customize > Plugins (marketplace from a GitHub repo). Plugin-bundled skills work in Claude Chat (web and Desktop) and Cowork alike; hooks and custom sub-agents run ONLY in Cowork and only when packaged inside an installed plugin — a workflow with worker agents must package as Plugin. No verified user-facing memory feature — do not assume Claude Code auto-memory exists here.

claude-ai.notes: Claude.ai web/Desktop chat. Guided mode, but skills are still markdown files packaged as a zip and uploaded via Customize > Skills (uploaded skills appear in Chat and Cowork alike), and plugins install from Customize > Plugins on paid plans — generate the skill source files and zip package rather than GUI instruction documents. No standalone sub-agent support (no agent key; plugin sub-agents run only in Cowork): worker agent specs ship inside the skill's agents/ folder and are dispatched by reading that file.

openai-codex.notes: Codex CLI, the Codex tab of the ChatGPT desktop app, and the IDE extension. Skills are folders read from $CWD/.agents/skills up to the repo root, then ~/.agents/skills (user-level default), then /etc/codex/skills; invoke with $skill-name or /skills. Plugins install from a marketplace (Plugins > Add marketplace in the app, or `codex plugin marketplace add owner/repo` in the CLI); ChatGPT and Codex share one plugin directory.

gemini-enterprise.notes: Work/school Google accounts on Standard, Plus, or Pay-as-you-go editions. Skills upload as Markdown or a zip with SKILL.md in the root directory via Skills > + > Upload skill > Import; invoke with @ or /. Skills are not available inside Gemini Enterprise agents. Personal Google accounts use Gemini Spark instead (see gemini-spark).

gemini-spark.notes: Spark is a mode of the Gemini app (Change mode > Switch to Spark) on the web, the Mac app, and Android/iOS. Personal Google accounts only (not Workspace), Google AI Pro or Ultra, 18+; not available in the EEA, UK, Switzerland, or Nigeria. Skills upload as a SKILL.md or a zip containing one via Skills > Upload; invoke with / in a task or let Spark pick automatically. Skill names must be lowercase-hyphenated.

chatgpt.notes: ChatGPT Chat/Work on web, desktop, and mobile. Skills upload as a zip or SKILL.md under Plugins > Skills > Create > Upload from your computer (paid plans except Free/Go; off by default on Enterprise/Edu until an admin enables); invoke with @skill-name in Work. Plugins (Pro/Business/Enterprise) install from Plugins > Add marketplace; plugin-bundled skills work across web, desktop, and mobile. Custom GPTs are deprecated — package agent-shaped work as a Workspace Agent with skills attached.
